description: Epicenter Settings (the `home` window). It administers the one active local transcription model: which model is active, downloading model files and showing their folders, and the unload policy (ADR-0180); model identity is administration data, so `get_active_model` is granted here and nowhere else, and Settings claims the section an app asked it to open (take_pending_home_section). It lists, adds, edits, and removes this computer's AI connections (ADR-0557, ADR-0587), each kept by the `epicenter` CLI in app data with its endpoint and key in the keychain, through the narrow CLI runner, which never hands the key back; it opens no folder. It signs the app in and out and shows who it is signed in as (ADR-0558): each is one fixed `epicenter auth` invocation with `--desktop`, and the shell opens only the deployment's authorization page the CLI names; no token reaches the page. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
